8066._name: Rainbow Bay (Lunar Voyage area 1, ending 'Dreamy Rainbow')
8066.beginText: The lake in Rainbow Bay shows seven colors. It`s beautiful! I want to paint a rainbow picture to record the beauty of Rainbow Bay! In this Flower Garden, there are flowers of various colors. Please collect some flowers of different colors for me. I want to make them into pigments of various colors!
8066.progressText: You still need to collect some Rose to make red pigment, and some Lavender to make purple pigment.
8066.finishText: Great! I`m missing these three colors! Thank you!

8067._name: Ring Mountain (Lunar Voyage area 2, ending 'Bound Foes')
8067.beginText: I was in a good mood. Who knew I`d run into this arrogant and rude fellow! Nasty fox! I`m going to pluck all its fox fur! Nasty Flame Fox! You must help me teach it a harsh lesson!
8067.progressText: Jade Rabbit has encountered its nemesis, Flame Fox, but Jade Rabbit is no match for the fox. Go help it! (59,59)
8067.finishText: You did great, really satisfying! Thank you for helping me out!
8067._note: [2026-10-15] official 'Defeat [mob FlameFox,1003075,59,59]': FlameFox = festival monster 22790 (official monster.dat 22790 lv120 120000 HP, DERIVED look FireRat 602), spawned for the player at (59,59) when the quest is taken.

8073._name: Clean Trash (Lunar Voyage area 6, ending 'Lunar Guardian')
8073.beginText: The trash left by the tourists not only affects the beauty but also emits a foul smell. We must take action and make all this trash disappear! Will you help me clean up the trash?
8073.progressText: There are still some leftover noodles over there. Please clean them up!
8073.finishText: Protecting the environment is everyone`s responsibility. I hope everyone can work together to protect the ecology of the moon. Thank you!
